title: Comprehensive Security Vulnerability Assessment
problem_statement: Banking application lacks basic security controls for authentication, data protection, and SQL injection prevention
risk_if_unaddressed: Critical data breach, regulatory compliance violations, financial fraud exposure
suggested_approach: 1) Implement parameterized queries 2) Add password hashing 3) Encrypt PII fields 4) Add input validation 5) Implement audit logging

title: Implement Comprehensive Error Handling
problem_statement: No error handling in form event handlers creates poor user experience and debugging challenges
risk_if_unaddressed: Application crashes, data corruption, poor user experience
suggested_approach: Add On Error GoTo statements, create centralized error logging module, implement user-friendly error messages
success_criteria: All event handlers have error handling

title: Create Database Abstraction Layer
problem_statement: Hardcoded database connections and direct table access creates tight coupling and deployment issues
risk_if_unaddressed: Deployment failures, difficult database migrations, poor scalability
suggested_approach: Create connection manager class, implement repository pattern, externalize connection strings

title: VB6 to Modern Platform Migration Strategy
problem_statement: VB6 platform is deprecated with limited support and modern integration challenges
risk_if_unaddressed: Technical obsolescence, security vulnerabilities, maintenance difficulties
suggested_approach: 1) Stabilize current system 2) Extract business logic 3) Migrate to .NET/web platform 4) Implement modern UI

title: Implement Automated Testing Strategy
problem_statement: No evidence of automated testing creates regression risk during modernization
risk_if_unaddressed: Regression bugs, difficult refactoring, poor code quality
suggested_approach: Create test harness for VB6 code, implement database fixtures, add UI automation tests
